transcript.t: Ben, we must choose a person we look up to for our class talk.
I will choose my aunt. She is a nurse in a small hospital.
During a bad flood, she worked for two days without a break to help the wounded.
Above all, she is kind to everyone. What about you?
I choose my math teacher. She dropped out of school as a girl, but she studied at night and later became a teacher.

sections.title: 一、听材料，选择正确答案

questions.why: She is a nurse in a small hospital.

questions.stem: How long did Ben's aunt work without a break during the flood?
questions.why: worked for two days without a break.

questions.stem: How did Amy's teacher become a teacher?
options: She learned it from a TV show.
questions.why: she studied at night and later became a teacher.

sections.title: 二、听材料，填写所缺的词或数字

questions.stem: Ben's aunt helped the ____ in the flood.
Above all, she is ____ to everyone.
